name: Thabo Nkosi
bio:
Thabo's journey into motorsport began with a childhood spent tinkering with his grandfather's old bakkie in rural KwaZulu-Natal. He quickly developed a knack for understanding how things worked, and a passion for efficiency. After completing his studies in logistics management at the University of Johannesburg, he sought to combine his skills with his love of racing. 

He approaches his role with a methodical, no-nonsense attitude. Thabo is known for his meticulous planning and ability to anticipate potential problems before they arise. He believes in clear communication and streamlined processes, ensuring that all logistical operations run smoothly and efficiently. His perfectionist tendencies drive him to constantly seek improvements and optimize every aspect of the team's transportation and supply chain.

physical.description: Thabo is a lean, athletic man with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, meticulously documenting everything.
Insists on using military time, even in casual conversations.
Has an uncanny ability to predict traffic patterns.
